Maya (People Ops): We've pushed a handbook update this morning: Data Retention & Privacy notice changes plus a short mandatory "Security & Data Handling" microtraining. Read: https://redwood.internal/handbook/data-retention. TL;DR: retention windows revised for logs and customer data (see table); personal data requests flow updated; all employees must complete the 12-minute Security & Data Handling microtraining and sign the data-handling attestation by 2026-05-20. Managers: confirm completion in the training tracker by 2026-05-25. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/data-retention-tracker. New joiners must complete within 7 days of start.

Ethan (Security): Note: this also changes how long debug logs are kept in staging: staging logs now 30 days (was 90). If you have long-running jobs that rely on older logs, let us know.

Ravi (HRBP): Are contractors required to do the microtraining?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, all contractors with access to company systems must complete it and sign the attestation. Hiring Ops please flag contractors in the tracker as "contractor" so we can batch reminders.

Clara (Hiring Ops): Will do. For offers pending, do we mark them as pending eligible? Also, how do we handle rehired alums who may have completed an older version?

Maya (People Ops): Mark pending hires as "pending-start"; once they onboard their pass will update. For rehires: if they finished the training <=12 months ago we consider it valid; otherwise they need to re-take. If it's a minor content update (patch) we'll auto-accept previous completion and just ask for attestation.

Liam (IC): Is there a retroactive exception process? I have a teammate who starts next week but missed the 7-day window.

Maya (People Ops): Exceptions are possible for start-date conflicts. Submit a ticket to people-ops with manager sign-off. We'll process exceptions weekly.

compliance-bot: Training assigned to Liam (IC) — Security & Data Handling microtraining — ts=2654321015 — url=https://redwood.internal/training/2654321015

Ethan (Security): Also reminder: signing the attestation is required before you can access PII datasets. If you need early access for an urgent bug, coordinate with Security for a temporary waiver.

Ravi (HRBP): Action items: managers confirm tracker by 2026-05-25; Hiring Ops flag contractors/pending hires; employees complete the microtraining + sign attestation by 2026-05-20. I'll run a compliance export on 2026-05-26 and nudge non-completers.

Clara (Hiring Ops): Flagged pending hires and two contractors in the tracker.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks, team. :thumbsup:
